title: Patch: bot-calibrate writes its results into the server config, and the seed ratings are read from the skill curve

**Issue #3115 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3115: Patch: bot-calibrate writes its results into the server config, and the seed ratings are read from the skill curve
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### Kind

Architecture

### Why

With sets shipping every month or two (owner, 2026-11-05, expects hundreds of new cards a month), the ladder bots' calibration is redone often, and every time a person pastes numbers by hand:

- `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` (`crates/server/src/config.rs`) says "a new best AI, or a set that ships, is measured again … and the rows pasted over".
- `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` restates the same five Elo numbers as `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`, and only a test keeps the two equal.
- `jackioh-server bot-calibrate` prints rows "to paste into crates/server/src/config.rs" (`crates/server/src/cli/bot_calibrate.rs`).

### What to change

High level; the planner decides the details:

- `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` is computed from `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` (or the reverse) in `const`, so the numbers live in one place.
- `bot-calibrate --write` rewrites those rows and `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` in place, as `cargo jackioh sweep --write` already does for the shadow ban. Printing stays the default.
- No values change. No subcommand or flag a person or workflow uses is removed (CLAUDE.md rule 13). Scheduling a calibration is out of scope.

### Acceptance

- Running `--write` on the current calibration's results leaves no diff.
- A test covers the writer.
- The server suite and clippy are green.

### Blocked by, part of

Related: #748, #1680.

### Difficulty (a guess)

medium

### Priority

No priority

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-8` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41975124334)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** The ladder bots' calibration is written into the server config by a command, and the seed ratings have one home, the skill curve. `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` becomes a `const` read off `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`, so no number is stated twice. `jackioh-server bot-calibrate --write` rewrites `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION`, `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` and the `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` rows in `crates/server/src/config.rs` in place. Printing stays the default. No value changes, so `--write` on the current calibration (`[1517, 1576, 1666, 1716, 1832]`, generation 13) leaves no diff. A test covers the writer. No subcommand or flag is removed; the only caller of `bot-calibrate` is a person, since nothing under `.github`, `.harness`, `.squishy`, `bot` or `.claude` runs it.

**Files to touch**

| File | | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/server/src/config.rs` | change | `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` computed by a new `const fn`; doc comments of `BOT_SEED_RATINGS`, `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` and `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` say `--write` instead of "paste" |
| `crates/server/src/cli/bot_calibrate.rs` | change | `--write` flag; `CONFIG_RS`; `config_items`, `rewrite_config`, `write_config`; `render_calibration` prints the new items; `run` writes; header and `USAGE` text |
| `crates/server/src/main.rs` | change | doc comment on `Command::BotCalibrate` only |
| `crates/server/tests/bots/calibrate.rs` | change | new writer tests; update two existing tests |
| `crates/server/README.md` | change | the `bots::calibrate` bullet (~line 772) and "Re-measuring" step 3 (~line 836) |
| `docs/bot-calibration.md` | change | the intro (lines 9-16) and step 2 of "After an AI promotion" (lines 99-109). Leave the Results sections: they are history. |
| `spec/rulings/R748000.md` | change | the "Seeds" and "After an AI promotion" paragraphs, a sentence each; front matter unchanged |
| `training/README.md` | change | one sentence, ~line 456: "pasted" becomes "written with `--write`" |

Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`, `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, or `crates/server/tests/bots/seat.rs` and `tests/api/bots.rs` (both keep passing as they are). The governing notes are R748000, R747000 and R1454, and CLAUDE.md rule 9. This is tooling, not a rules decision, so there is no new ruling, no `spec/pending` file and no patch fragment. No catalog change is made.

**Steps**

1. `config.rs`, `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` (~line 1236). Replace the literal with the following (checked: it compiles on 1.97, and `BOT_STRENGTHS` still reads `BOT_SEED_RATINGS[i]` in `const`):
   ```rust
   pub const BOT_SEED_RATINGS: [f64; SKILL_ELO_TABLE.len()] = seed_ratings_from_curve();

   const fn seed_ratings_from_curve() -> [f64; SKILL_ELO_TABLE.len()] {
       let mut seeds = [0.0; SKILL_ELO_TABLE.len()];
       let mut index = 0;
       while index < seeds.len() {
           seeds[index] = SKILL_ELO_TABLE[index].1;
           index += 1;
       }
       seeds
   }
   ```
   Rewrite its doc comment: the seeds are `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`'s Elo column, read off in `const` (R747000, R748000); `bot-calibrate --write` rewrites the rows (`docs/bot-calibration.md`). Drop "prints rows to paste here and over `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`". In the docs of `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` and `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`, change "the rows pasted over" to "rewritten by `bot-calibrate --write`". Change no value. If rustc rejects the `.len()` array length, use `[f64; 5]` in both places; the test in step 8 holds the two lengths equal anyway.

2. `bot_calibrate.rs`, options. Add `pub write: bool` to `CalibrateOptions`, default `false` in `parse_calibrate_args`. At the top of the `for arg in argv` loop, before `flag(arg)`, add `if arg == "--write" { options.write = true; continue; }`. `flag()` only takes `--name=value`, so `--write=1` still falls into `_ => bail!("Unrecognized option …")`. Add `[--write]` to the usage line in the module doc and `USAGE`, and a `--write` entry: "Rewrite BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION, SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR and the SKILL_ELO_TABLE rows in crates/server/src/config.rs (run from the repository root) after printing the report. BOT_SEED_RATINGS follows from the table. Default: print only."

3. `bot_calibrate.rs`, the items. Add `pub const CONFIG_RS: &str = "crates/server/src/config.rs";` (from the repository root, as `--history` is). Add:
   ```rust
   pub fn config_items(seeds: &[f64], generation: i64) -> Vec<(&'static str, String)>
   ```
   It returns three `(const name, text)` pairs, in this order, using these exact formats:
   - `("BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION", "pub const BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION: i64 = {generation};\n")`
   - `("SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR", "pub const SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR: f64 = {last:.1};\n")`, where `last` is `seeds.last()`, or `0.0` if there are none.
   - `("SKILL_ELO_TABLE", …)`: the first line `pub const SKILL_ELO_TABLE: &[(f64, f64)] = &[\n`, then one row per seed zipped with `BOT_STRENGTHS[i].skill`, each `    ({skill:?}, {seed:.1}),\n`. The row of the last seed reads `    ({skill:?}, SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR),\n`. Then `];\n`. `{:?}` of an `f64` gives `0.0`, `0.25` and `1.0`, which is how the file spells them.

4. `bot_calibrate.rs`, the writer.
   - `pub fn rewrite_config(text: &str, seeds: &[f64], generation: i64) -> anyhow::Result<String>`. First `bail!` if any of these hold: `seeds.len() != BOT_STRENGTHS.len()`; a seed is not finite; the seeds are not strictly ascending (`windows(2)`; the curve's rows rise with skill, R747000). Then, for each `(name, new)` from `config_items`, call a private `replace_item(text, name, new)`. It takes `lines: Vec<&str> = text.split_inclusive('\n').collect()` and finds the one line that starts with `pub const {name}:`, with an error if there are none or two. It then takes `end`, the first index at or after that line whose `trim_end()` ends in `;`, with an error if none, and returns `lines[..start].concat() + new + lines[end + 1..].concat()`. This is already prototyped: it reproduces the current `config.rs` byte for byte.
   - `pub fn write_config(path: &Path, seeds: &[f64], generation: i64) -> anyhow::Result<bool>` reads the file, calls `rewrite_config`, writes only if the text differs, and returns whether it did.

5. `bot_calibrate.rs`, `render_calibration`. Replace the last block, the `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` and `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` lines. Keep a comment line: `// jackioh-server bot-calibrate: paste over the items of these names, crates/server/src/config.rs, or run again with --write` (`BOT_SEED_RATINGS` follows from the table). Then push each text from `config_items(&report.seeds, report.generation)`. The printed block must never contain `pub const BOT_SEED_RATINGS`, which would break the `const`. Printing never validates, so a bad result still prints.

6. `bot_calibrate.rs`, `run`. Right after parsing the options, if `options.write`, read `CONFIG_RS` (error: "--write cannot read {CONFIG_RS}: … (run from the repository root)"). Then call `rewrite_config(&text, &BOT_SEED_RATINGS, BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION)?` and discard the result. This fails in seconds, not after the hour of games. After `print!("{}", render_calibration(&report))`, if `options.write`, call `write_config(Path::new(CONFIG_RS), &report.seeds, report.generation)?` and `eprintln!` "bot-calibrate: rewrote {CONFIG_RS}" or "bot-calibrate: {CONFIG_RS} already holds these rows". Update the module header: the rows are written by `--write` or pasted by hand, and a change still reaches a ladder bot only through a pull request. Replace "no number reaches a ladder bot without a person reading it first".

7. `main.rs`: change the `Command::BotCalibrate` doc comment to "…print their seed ratings (or rewrite them in config with `--write`) (R748000)". Nothing else changes.

8. Tests: see below. Then update the docs from step 9.

9. Docs. In `crates/server/README.md`, the `bots::calibrate` bullet: the table is the one source, `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` is read off it, and `--write` rewrites the three items. "Re-measuring" step 3: replace "paste the rows over `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` and `BOT_SEED_RATINGS`" with "paste them over `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`; `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` follows, and `r747000_strength_seed_ratings_match_skill_curve` still holds each strength's seed to the curve". `docs/bot-calibration.md` and `spec/rulings/R748000.md`: replace "paste the printed `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` row over …" with "run again with `--write`, or paste the printed items over `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION`, `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` and `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`; `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` is read off the table". `training/README.md`: one phrase.

**Tests** (all in `crates/server/tests/bots/calibrate.rs`, which is already in R748000's `proven_in`). Add `const CONFIG: &str = include_str!("../../src/config.rs");` and import `rewrite_config`, `write_config`, `config_items`, `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` and `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION`.

- `r748000_the_seed_ratings_are_read_off_the_skill_curve` (new) asserts `BOT_SEED_RATINGS.len() == SKILL_ELO_TABLE.len()` and `BOT_SEED_RATINGS[i] == SKILL_ELO_TABLE[i].1` for every row.
- `r748000_write_on_the_current_calibration_leaves_no_diff` (new) asserts `rewrite_config(CONFIG, &BOT_SEED_RATINGS, BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION)` equals `CONFIG`. Do not hard-code 1517 and the rest: a later calibration written by `--write` must not break this test.
- `r748000_write_rewrites_only_the_calibrations_rows` (new):
  - Seeds are `1001.0 + 111.0 * i` for each strength and generation is `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION + 1`.
  - The output has the same number of lines as `CONFIG`.
  - Every line that differs starts with `pub const BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION`, `pub const SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` or `    (`.
  - It contains the new generation line, the anchor line (the last seed) and the row `    (0.0, 1001.0),`.
  - The output contains the unchanged `pub const SKILL_ELO_TABLE` row `    (1.0, SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR),` and no `pub const BOT_SEED_RATINGS: [f64; 5] = [` literal.
  - A second `rewrite_config` with the same arguments on the output returns it unchanged.
- `r748000_write_refuses_what_the_curve_cannot_hold` (new) asserts `rewrite_config` returns `Err` for:
  - descending seeds;
  - the wrong count (`&[1.0, 2.0]`);
  - a `NaN` seed;
  - a text lacking `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` (`"pub const BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION: i64 = 1;\n"`), where the error names `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR`.
- `r748000_write_config_writes_the_file_only_when_it_changes` (new): temp dir `std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("jackioh-bot-calibrate-{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()))`, as `tests/store/card_stats.rs:803` does. Write `CONFIG` into it.
  - `write_config` with the current values returns `Ok(false)` and leaves the file equal to `CONFIG`.
  - With `generation + 1` it returns `Ok(true)`, and the file then holds `= {generation + 1};`.
  - Remove the directory at the end.
- `r748000_bot_calibrate_parses_its_flags` (update): add `write: false` to the default `CalibrateOptions` and the every-flag case with `--write` added and `write: true`. Assert that `--write=1` is an error.
- `r748000_the_report_prints_the_rows_to_paste` (update): the fake report becomes five strengths, offsets `-413.0, -300.0, -200.0, -100.0, 0.0`, seeds `[787.0, 900.0, 1000.0, 1100.0, 1200.0]` (the report's `seeds` field; the anchor 1200 and generation 9 stay). Assert that `text` contains each text from `config_items(&seeds, 9)`, that it contains `    (0.0, 787.0),` and `    (1.0, SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR),`, and that it does not contain `pub const BOT_SEED_RATINGS`. Keep the `| 0 v 1 | 5 | 2 | 33 | 0 |` assertion.

Commands:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server r748000`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server r747000`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`

**Done when**
- [ ] `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` is read off `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` in `const`, and no seed number appears twice.
- [ ] `bot-calibrate --write` rewrites `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION`, `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` and the table rows; printing stays the default, and `bot-calibrate-live` and every flag still work.
- [ ] The no-diff test passes and the writer tests exist.
- [ ] `git diff` shows no value change in `config.rs`.
- [ ] Server suite, clippy (the server crate), rustfmt and `spec check` are green; the workspace clippy and cargo-tests checks listed for the harness then pass.
- [ ] Docs, README and the R748000 note no longer tell a person to paste a `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` row.

**Risks**
- Pasting the old printed `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` row would now break the `const`. Step 5 therefore stops printing it, and a test asserts it is absent.
- The writer matches `pub const NAME:` at the start of a line and ends an item at the first line ending in `;`. This is exact for the three items today (round-trip checked). A reformat of them breaks the writer loudly (an error, never a silent edit), and the no-diff test catches it.
- A `--write` after a promotion moves `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR`, which the curve and the ceiling gate read, and so every seed (R1453). A person still reviews the pull request, and `r747000_expected_elo_reads_the_table_by_straight_lines` guards ascending order.
- The server crate is not one of the five pure crates, so file I/O in the CLI is allowed, as `read_history` already does.
- The seed tests in `seat.rs` and `api/bots.rs` read the constants and should pass unchanged; run the whole `server` test binary.

**Open questions.**
- None blocks the build.
- I kept the strengths' skills in `BOT_STRENGTHS`; the table's skill column restates them, a test holds them equal, and the writer regenerates the column from `BOT_STRENGTHS`. Deriving the table's skills from the strengths in `const` was rejected as a bigger change to `config.rs` for no number saved.
- The issue's difficulty (medium) stands: one crate, no engine, AI or migration change, and about 8 files.
````
